Results.ReviewText:
This is my third Weber (first gas Weber), and I am anticipating the same quality and longevity as I’ve enjoyed with my others. I love the fine tuning adjustability of the Spirit II 2-burner grill, which allows for those maintained tempurature ranges necessary for longer cooks.

The overall construction of this Weber is top notch, with one exception — that pesky drop down table. As it is on the side one would intuitively use to wheel the grill from place to place, it seems equally counterintuitive that the drop down table is as flimsy as it is. My first attempt to move my grill resulted in the front side attachment point disengaging. I checked to make sure everything was fitted as indicated in the manual and reattempted to wheel the grill across our deck. Again the table disengaged. This really isn’t a deal breaker for me because I do not anticipate moving the grill all that much. As a matter of fact, I doubt I will even utilize the drop down feature. Perhaps I’ll simply bolt it solid to the frame and be done with the issue altogether.

This design feature aside, I would still recommend this grill. The two burner size is perfect for the couple who like to grill for themselves and/or a handful of friends.
Results.Title: Pesky drop-down table

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
